## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长计算

**原始数据**（来源：`financial_statements.txt` 第 18895 字符位置，Three Months Ended June 30 同比对比表）：
- FY26 Q4（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日三个月）：Intelligent Cloud 收入 **$39,306 百万**
- FY25 Q4（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日三个月）：Intelligent Cloud 收入 **$29,878 百万**

**计算过程**：
- 增长额 = 39,306 − 29,878 = **$9,428 百万**
- 同比增长率 = 9,428 ÷ 29,878 = **31.55%**，按公司披露口径四舍五入为 **32%**（按固定汇率口径为 31%）

该口径与电话会一致：`transcript.txt`（第 24700 字符）明确表述："Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency."

---

### 2. 管理层归因（电话会原话）

来源：`transcript.txt` 第 24700–27200 字符，Phil Spencer / Amy Hood 对 Intelligent Cloud 的评论：

> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by **efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.** That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"

补充（on-premises server 业务）：
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by **renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"

---

### 3. 归因分类：已发生事实 vs 前瞻性表述

| 归因 | 性质 | 判定依据 |
|---|---|---|
| Azure 收入同比增长 43% | **已发生事实** | 电话会使用"grew 43%"的过去时陈述，且财报表内已披露该数字（`financial_statements.txt`） |
| 客户需求持续超过可用产能（Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity） | **已发生事实（含当前状态判断）** | 用"continues to exceed"描述当前持续状态；管理层以此解释本季度超预期，属于对当期状况的总结 |
| CPU/GPU 集群效率提升及流程改进使新产能更早交付 | **已发生事实** | "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains..."——用过去时归因已实现的超预期增长 |
| 本季度新增产能被快速变现（quickly monetized） | **已发生事实** | 描述本季度已完成的变现行为 |
| GitHub Copilot 消费强于预期（6月商业模式调整对齐定价与使用价值后） | **已发生事实** | "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected..."——对本季度已实现业绩的归因 |
| On-premises server 续约合同结构带来更高的期内收入确认 | **已发生事实** | 描述已完成的本季度业绩表现 |
| "We remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps as customer demand continues to exceed supply"（下季度展望部分） | **前瞻性表述** | 位于 outlook 部分（`transcript.txt` 第 32535 字符），"remain focused"、"bridge the gaps"是对未来行动的承诺，非已实现结果 |
| "We continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | **前瞻性表述** | 明确使用"continue to expect"对未来半财年增速加速做出预测 |
| "we continue to expect FX to decrease revenue growth in Intelligent Cloud by less than 1 point"（Q1 指引） | **前瞻性表述** | 明确是下季度汇率影响预期 |

**区分方法论**：主要依据两个维度——(a) 动词时态与情态动词（过去时"grew / was / benefited" vs 将来时"expect / remain focused / will"）；(b) 上下文段落归属（业绩回顾段 vs outlook 指引段）。本季度业绩归因全部来自"Next, the Intelligent Cloud segment"至"Operating income grew 31%..."这一段业绩回顾，而前瞻性表述集中出现在"Now to the outlook"之后的段落。
